item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\np={'edges':{'a>b':{},'b>c':{'role':'admin'},'c>d':{'retry':True},'d>e':{'retry':True,'role':'admin'}},'retry_limit':2}\\ncases=[({'from':'x','to':'y'},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'user','attempts':False},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),({'from':'c','to':'d'},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'c','to':'d','attempts':False},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'c','to':'d','attempts':-1},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'c','to':'d','attempts':0},{'ok':True,'value':'d','reason':'ok'}),({'from':'c','to':'d','attempts':1},{'ok':True,'value':'d','reason':'ok'}),({'from':'c','to':'d','attempts':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':99},{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'})]\\nfor req,expected in cases:\\n rb=copy.deepcopy(req); pb=copy.deepcopy(p); got=evaluate(req,p)\\n assert got==expected,(req,got,expected)\\n assert req==rb and p==pb\\n assert set(got)=={'ok','value','reason'}\\nprint(json.dumps({'passed':len(cases),'cases':[{'request':r,'expected':e} for r,e in cases]}))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: p=json.load(f)\\nactual=[evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert actual==report,(actual,report)\\nprint(json.dumps(actual))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"show\",\"HEAD:work.py\"]}}]}"}
